g.text: L2_AUDIO block loop: one iteration per 4 ms block
prime 4 silent TX blocks, start RX, then TX
waits for the next completed RX block, at most 20 ms (P11)
take the left slot (even index) of each of the 64 frames
into the 64-entry mono working buffer (low 8 bits cleared)
RX block back to the RX pool
Processing budget (P02): from the received block
to the queued TX block at most 3 ms of the 4 ms period;
the receive wait is not part of it.
No lock is held across a block wait.
The thread holds at most one RX and one TX block:
RX is returned before TX is requested.
apply the selected listening filter and the volume
waits for a free TX block, at most 20 ms (P11)
write each mono sample into both slots of its frame
L1_I2S returns the block to the TX pool,
i2s_abort: DROP on both links at once
fault event with the failed link to L2_CONTROL
